parsed_json.up: Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value from activities joined to assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures. Filter to target CHEMBL1275217, standard_type IC50, standard_relation '=', and pchembl_value not null. Keep every qualifying activity row; do not deduplicate. Sort by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Limit to 1000 rows.
